decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The conversion of the existing dwellinghouse into two one bedroom flats and a studio flat is not considered appropriate, as the original dwelling is not large enough for conversion, nor would a family sized unit be retained.  It would result in the loss of a small house that is suitable for single-family occupation and is therefore contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

2.	The conversion of the existing dwellinghouse into two one bedroom flats and a studio flat would be likely to result in the generation of noise and general disturbance beyond that of a single family dwelling, to the detriment of the living conditions of surrounding residents and is contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

3.	The proposal would result in a shortfall of one on-site car parking space, which would be likely to lead to increased congestion, which would be detrimental to the free and safe flow of traffic and is considered contrary with policies H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

4.	The proposed conversion would result in the creation of a unit and a number of rooms that do not meet with the minimum requirements of internal space guidelines, to the detriment of the living conditions of the occupiers of the units and contrary with policy H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse into two self-contained flats.
